where: Section 1 (formula explainer) and Quiz Q1 answer
problem: The power set is written as 2<sup>Q</sup> in the displayed formula but as plain "2Q" in the sentence "2Q is the power set of Q" and in the Q1 answer "δ: Q × Σ → 2Q". A student copying this may write 2Q, which reads as two times Q.
fix: Write it as 2<sup>Q</sup> everywhere: "δ: Q × Σ → 2<sup>Q</sup>, where 2<sup>Q</sup> is the power set of Q, the set of all subsets of Q".

problem: The union is written "⋃q ∈ P δ(q, a)" with the index on the same line, so it can be read as multiplying by q. The symbol δ̂ is also the usual notation for the string-extended function on a single state, δ̂(q, w), which the subset-construction chapter uses.
fix: Write "δ̂(P, a) = ⋃<sub>q ∈ P</sub> δ(q, a), the union of δ(q, a) over every state q in the set P", and add one line saying this set version is not the same as the string version δ̂(q, w) used later.

problem: "The figure shows q0 looping on 0 and 1..." points to the figure, but the figure is placed after Section 3, far below. On a phone the reader sees the reference before the picture.
fix: Say "the figure below shows ...", or move the figure up to Section 1 so the loop on 0, 1 and the arrow to q1 on 1 are visible where they are first described.

problem: "The machine may stay in q, move to another state, or have no move at all" reads as if staying is always allowed. Staying in q on symbol a is possible only when q ∈ δ(q, a).
fix: "The machine may stay in q (when q ∈ δ(q, a)), move to one or more other states, or have no move at all (δ(q, a) = ∅)."

where: Whole chapter, plus Section 3 "ending in ab" bullet
problem: The start state is written q₀ in the formal tuple and q0 in the traces and tables, so a reader may think these are two different things. The "ending in ab" bullet also uses "δ(q2, ·) = ∅" without saying what the dot · means.
fix: Use one spelling throughout, for example q0 in the diagrams and q₀ only inside the tuple, and add "where · stands for either input symbol: δ(q2, 0) = δ(q2, 1) = ∅".
